payload.body: Crate CR-108 follow-up on 2026-06-12: a fresh Rust auth audit still finds no BootSeams/AppDefinition first-sign-in lifecycle hook. Built-in auth routes are merged before app routes, so Crate cannot shadow /auth/email/signup, /auth/apple/verify, /auth/google/verify, or /auth/oidc/:id/verify. Minimal upstream seam remains: invoke an app hook only for successful new-account email/provider sign-in before session minting; pass store/account/provider context; allow Crate to create tenant ledger/schema rows and return session tenant fields; skip existing-account logins. Crate now has real web/iOS/Android seeded restore/read smoke against the Rust host, but production first-session creation remains blocked here.
